props.author: Stoiiic
props.text:
Concluding remarks on BTC consolidation: unable to push through 65, accepting back to low side (~62.5) on low volume for weeks (bearish lean = heavy disinterest, no sustained spot buying).

What would flip upside conviction: consecutive ETF inflow days + acceptance back above 64 POC.

Levels: 63–64.5K = supply; 62s = reflexivity for lower (targets high 50s-60). Few high conviction setups on BTC to trade currently.
